_about: MedSafe-Dx v0.3 draft-3 prompt test (spec/v0.3-scoring.md section 12). The values are run_config_v03.json's (spec section 9: max_tokens 16000, reasoning effort 'medium' where the model supports it, one retry on an empty or truncated response); only the prompt (v7, five arms) and config_version differ. inference/run_inference.py --prompt-version v7a1|v7a2|v7a3|v7a4a|v7a4b reads it and records the arm as the row's prompt_version. reasoning_effort null means we send no reasoning parameter (the Llama models take none).
